component.name: lpm
component.summary: Switch between projects and terminals in seconds

description.p: Start, stop, duplicate and switch between your dev projects with a single click, with a built-in terminal for running AI coding agents like Claude Code and Codex alongside your services.

ul.li: Start every service in a project with one click, each with a log tab of its own
Run Claude Code, Codex and other agents in the built-in terminal
Give each agent its own copy of the project, so agents don't get in each other's way
Switch projects without stopping what's running

screenshot.caption: A project's services and a terminal in one window
